definitions.explanation: The historical period of Emperor Meiji's reign, 1868–1912, when Japan rapidly modernized and Westernized after the end of the feudal Edo period.

examples.japanese: {明治|めいじ}{時代|じだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧。
examples.english: a writer born in the Meiji period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{明治|めいじ}{時代|じだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{近代化|きんだいか}→近代化：15055_kindaika⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Japan modernized greatly during the Meiji period.

examples.japanese: {明治|めいじ}{時代|じだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{西洋|せいよう}→西洋：01446_seiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧や⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{取|と}り{入|い}れられた→取り入れる：04221_toriireru⟧。
examples.english: During the Meiji period, Western culture and technology were adopted one after another.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{明治|めいじ}→明治：19860_meiji⟧ (the era name) + ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧ (period, era). Refers to 1868–1912, when Japan transformed from a feudal society into a modern industrial nation-state.

KEY ASSOCIATIONS:
- ⟦{明治維新|めいじいしん}→明治維新：16286_meijiishin⟧: the Meiji Restoration (1868)
- ⟦{文明開化|ぶんめいかいか}→文明開化：15959_bunmeikaika⟧: the 'civilization and enlightenment' of rapid Westernization

RELATED PERIODS:
- ⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧: Edo period — the preceding feudal era
- {大正|たいしょう}⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧: Taisho period — the era that followed (1912–1926)
